description: The org's legible taste in ONE read: brand kits, registered critics (the machine-checkable standard both the Director's gates and score_composition enforce), their reference media (presigned thumbnails), the recent checkpoint-decision log, and the learned `taste` (style preferences saved with remember_taste). Read this BEFORE composing for an org you haven't worked with — it is the house style. Learned taste is advice: the current request, brief, project, brand kit, exclusions and critics take precedence; name any conflict.
name: get_profile

brandKits.description: The org's brand kits (bind one to a project via update_project). `audio` carries the brand sound kit when set.

critics.description: Registered critics — run in the Director's gates AND score_composition.

recentDecisions.description: The last recorded checkpoint decisions — the raw log learned taste is saved from.

references.description: The union of critic reference media — the org's visual standard, with provenance.

taste.description: Learned style preferences. Advice only: the current request, its brief, the project and the brand kit, exclusions and critics all take precedence.

title: Get Profile
